title: 07 Service Status And Collection
description: Where the car is, approvals, the bill and collecting it. 6 cases: 3 agreed, 0 our design, 3 open.

nodes.title: Service Status And Collection
nodes.detail: Where the car is, approvals, the bill and collecting it. 6 cases: 3 agreed, 0 our design, 3 open.

nodes.title: “Where is my car? Is it done?”, or the status isn’t there
nodes.detail: Reads the status by booking number. If nothing shows, emails the service centre and gives a callback time, as the contact centre does today.

cases.when: “Where is my car? Is it done?”, or the status isn’t there
cases.agent_does: Reads the status by booking number. If nothing shows, emails the service centre and gives a callback time, as the contact centre does today.

nodes.title: Work is waiting for their approval, or extra work was found
nodes.detail: Tells them the centre needs their OK and emails the branch so the service advisor calls back.

cases.when: Work is waiting for their approval, or extra work was found
cases.agent_does: Tells them the centre needs their OK and emails the branch so the service advisor calls back.

nodes.title: “What will I pay when I collect it?”
nodes.detail: Doesn’t quote the final bill. Emails the branch so the service advisor calls back with the amount.

cases.when: “What will I pay when I collect it?”
cases.agent_does: Doesn’t quote the final bill. Emails the branch so the service advisor calls back with the amount.

nodes.title: The problem from the last visit is back, or the bill was higher than quoted
